intentEvidence: This is a fork of the original obsidian-auto-card-link by Nekoshita Yuki, and has been maintained by KreNtal since 2026-05-04.
motivation: Wanted to show beautiful links in my notes, didn't want to mess up my notes with HTML tags, and wanted to keep the original plugin updated.
problem: Standard link previews are often limited, and manually creating rich, styled links without messy HTML is difficult.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of the original obsidian-auto-card-link by Nekoshita Yuki

summary: Converts URLs into rich, card-styled blocks or clean Markdown links, fetching metadata like thumbnails and favicons for various websites.
